title: psilogramme flexuosa
intro: Psilogramme flexuosa, commonly known as the Slipper Orchid, is a plant species in the orchid family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Psilogramme flexuosa have been reported to include flavonoids such as kaempferol and quercetin, terpenoids such as ursolic acid, and phenolic acids such as caffeic acid and ferulic acid.
